+def _routes(data):
+    n = data["n"]
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bit_for = {node: 1 << i for i, node in enumerate(required)}
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    start_node = data["source"]
+    initial_mask = bit_for.get(start_node, 0)
+    coupons = data["coupons"]
+    deadline = data["deadline"]
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(n)]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+
+    start = data["start"]
+    initial = (start_node, initial_mask, 0)
+    best = {initial: start}
+    queue = [(start, start_node, initial_mask, 0)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, used = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, used)
+        if best.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full and used == coupons:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            for spend in (0, 1):
+                if used + spend > coupons:
+                    continue
+                duration = edge["duration"]
+                if spend:
+                    duration = max(1, duration - edge.get("discount", 0))
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > deadline:
+                    continue
+                nxt = edge["v"]
+                next_mask = mask | bit_for.get(nxt, 0)
+                next_state = (nxt, next_mask, used + spend)
+                if arrival < best.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    best[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, nxt, next_mask, used + spend))
